_comment: Golden State: what was done to this TV, not what version its apps are. Apps update all the time, so third-party app versions are NOT tracked here: a package is verified by presence only (check: presence), and its apk/sha256 are the install source provision uses when the app is missing, hash-checked before install, never compared against the TV. The one exception is the CleanTV launcher (check: exact): it is his own build, its version IS the QoL work, and provision installs exactly that build. The `tweaks` section records the actual work: plugins, add-ons, settings, DNS, ad blocking, video-player/browser-wrapper work, and launcher QoL. Do not hand-edit; re-run capture after changing anything on the TV.

what: Circular navigation: left from the first tile wraps to the last tile, right from the last wraps to the first (Home.java focusSearch).

Dim toggle: one-click Dim chip on the home screen; Guard accessibility overlay, 80% black (alpha 204, SmartTube paused-idle level), TRANSLUCENT, NOT_FOCUSABLE/NOT_TOUCHABLE, stays until untoggled, works while media plays. System brightness is NOT used: it does not move this TCL panel's backlight.
Guard accessibility service (tv.cleantv.home/tv.cleantv.home.Guard) takes HOME from Amazon's launcher. Any launcher force-stop/restart must rebind Guard afterward; a plain am start does not.
home.conf: dim_mode=off, dim=40 (image dim), rotate=visit, custom tile order, labels=focus, clock=auto.
personalDNSfilter (dnsfilter.android) runs as an always-on local VPN on the TV (settings always_on_vpn_app=dnsfilter.android, autostart on).
Blocklist is HaGeZi Amazon-only trackers plus data/blocklists/extra-hosts.txt and alexa-hosts.txt; Alexa hosts blocked. No general blocklists: they would risk the streaming apps for almost no gain.
dnsfilter.conf: detectDNS=false, routeUnderlyingDNS=true, fallbackDNS is the router (or DNS_UPSTREAM when set), filter auto-update disabled. SYSTEM_DNS=0 (Fire OS 7 keeps its clock without it).

SmartTube (org.smarttube.stable): a reimplementation with no ad code, ads are never requested. DNS filtering cannot block YouTube ads (same hosts as video). 2026-11-18 fixed2/fixed3/fixed4/fixed5: a mid-roll freeze recurred (variant playlist nearly all ad segments; stripping left ~0 segments and the player stalled and looped). fixed2 served the original variant when stripping left <3 segments (ads played instead of freezing). fixed3 swaps ad segments for an embedded 2s blank segment (black/silent) instead. fixed4 adds a variant-level playerType fallback: when the current variant strips to <3 segments it tries every playerType for a clean variant first, blank is the last resort. fixed5 (2026-11-18, sha256 c608b428...) authenticates the GQL token request with his Twitch OAuth token (Bearer), so Twitch honors his subscriptions: subbed channels get clean masters with no stripping or blanking. The token is embedded in the fixed5 build only and is never committed to this repo; the fixed5 APK is not in apps/ for that reason.

S0undTV / Twitch (PATCHED BUILD, 2026-11-11, supersedes the Luminous proxy): the app is now a patched build (patched2) with in-app ad blocking. A TtvAbProxy HTTP server runs inside the app on 127.0.0.1 (first free port 8901-8910); a smali hook at the top of G6/e.m() (the live URL builder) routes live streams through it. It is a faithful port of the Zen extension TTV AB v26.0.3: per playerType (site, embed, popout, mobile_web, autoplay) it fetches an anonymous GQL PlaybackAccessToken, gets the usher master playlist, serves the first master with 0 ad markers, and rewrites variant URLs through itself, stripping stitched-ad segments from variants. No proxy, no tunnel, no VM service, no PC in the chain. The update feature was deleted in smali the same day (UpdateHelper constructor, helpers/a.b(), UpdateHelper.d() all return immediately; no update.json fetch, UpdateActivity can never launch), so the app never nags about new versions and never shows the red update screen. Custom signature; keystore is NOT in the repo (kept on the VM at ~/workspace/twitch-proxy/patch/s0undtv-patch.keystore). Live ad-block CONFIRMED 2026-11-11 ~21:09 CT by him ("I haven't seen an ad in ages"): no pre-rolls or mid-rolls over his watching session. Fragility: if Twitch ever kills the anonymous token request the server uses, live streams fail to load instead of falling back to ads; if the server fails to start, the hook falls through to the app's original proxy/GQL logic (playback works, no blocking). HISTORICAL (superseded): the Luminous proxy method. It blocked pre-rolls ONLY, not mid-rolls. The proxy carries only the master playlist fetch; variant playlists are fetched direct from the TV's US IP, and Twitch stitches mid-roll pods into the variant playlist, so mid-rolls leak even when the master went through a no-ads exit. The earlier adb VIEW-intent trap claim is doubtful: a traffic log showed lb-as WAS resolved during an adb test launch. The Luminous proxy settings in the app are stale (server 3 was lb-as.cdn-perfprod.com) and are now ignored by the patched build; do not restore them. Chat settings (restored 2026-11-11 from the Oct 30 backup, then corrected to his explicit preference): position Top center + height Horizontal mode (a single horizontal bar across the top, messages scrolling across; the Oct 30 backup's Right bottom + 50% was stale), background opacity 60%, font 14, width Auto, emote bigger, background Default, input box Default, GIFs/sub messages/Prime/gifted/timestamp/keyboard/recent messages all on.
Kick / Rumble ads come from their own CDNs alongside content: blocking is partial and frequently breaks playback, not worth the fragility.
ad_blocking.settings_source: private/app-settings/app-settings.ab (Oct 30, 2026, sha256-verified; SmartTube ad/SponsorBlock/shorts settings, S0undTV chat settings) — used 2026-11-11 to restore S0undTV chat settings after the reinstall wipe; chat position corrected to Top center per his explicit preference (backup said Right bottom, stale). Restore is opt-in, unverified on another TV

what: WebView wrapper shells in apps/webwrap (frameXTV, ObbyWatcher): native MotionEvent taps and ACTION_HOVER_MOVE that reach into iframes and count as genuine user activation; container fullscreen pin that keeps the player's own controls; DPR scale derived from innerWidth (panel 3840x2160, Fire OS app layer 1920x1080).
Removed Nov 7, 2026 as deprecated (uninstalled from the TV): MMABite, StreamEast, AnimeHeaven, Miruro wrappers.
Wrapper source is the tweak: apps/webwrap (apps.txt, build.sh). Installed wrapper versions are not pinned; presence is what is checked.

Removed Nov 7, 2026 as deprecated (uninstalled from the TV): Watchbox plus its six Aniyomi extension APKs and the Watchbox repo deep link; CloudStream plus its phisher98/recloudstream extension repos; Arvio plus its add-ons (Torrentio, Comet, Flix-Streams Free, HdHub, OpenSubtitles v3); Lumera plus its add-ons (Cinemeta, Torrentio, Comet, OpenSubtitles v3, MediaFusion, Flix-Streams Free, HdHub).
Zangetsu: nine installed providers (AniKoto, 4K HDHub, UHD Movies, HDHub4u, HiAnime, VegaMovies, MultiMovies, AnimeCube, TorBox) from the zangetsu-providers index; TorBox needs its key re-entered.
Atlantic: content plugin is built into the APK, nothing to provision.

Lumora: live-TV/plugin shell (com.lumora 7.1). 5th tile in home.conf. JS plugins (Anime Senshi, Torrent Search, Reddit IPTV Scanner, Streaming Site List), Stremio add-ons (Cinemeta, WatchHub, OpenSubtitles v3, Torrentio, MediaFusion, Comet, AIOStreams), the epg6 guide, and the obnoxious.lol Jellyfin/ObnoxiousTV integration are manual in-app steps — full list in provision/lumora/README.md. Debrid keys, the Jellyfin account and the ObnoxiousTV manifest are his to supply, never committed. MMA/motorsports sports-tab code change is a patch in provision/lumora/ (BUILD.md); the live TV still runs stock v7.1 until a patched build ships.
home.conf (apps/home.conf): tile order, dim, dim_mode, rotate, labels, clock, inputs, hidden tiles, HDMI renames (PlayStation 5, PC).
Wallpaper apps/wallpapers/dark-waves.jpg; tile art in apps/art.
39 Amazon packages disabled (disabled_packages) plus CleanTV debloat/lockdown in cleantv/scripts/all.sh.
settings: always_on_vpn_app=dnsfilter.android, alarm_manager_constants min_futurity=0, enabled_accessibility_services includes the CleanTV Guard.
Aerial Views is the idle screensaver (not the dim).

packages.note: Installed build is fixed5 (2026-11-18, sha256 c608b4280eac12f967024f8a6f973a8a2fa711cd1815999ec84ca7855607803c): TtvAbProxy now authenticates its GQL PlaybackAccessToken requests with his Twitch OAuth token (Bearer), so Twitch honors his subscriptions and serves clean masters on subbed channels; keeps fixed4's variant-level playerType fallback and the blank-segment safety net from fixed3. The fixed5 APK is intentionally NOT in this repo: it embeds his OAuth token. The apk/sha256 below point to patched2, the last credential-free build in the repo, as the install source. Stock beta_147 (apps/s0undtv-beta147.apk, sha256 e191495df5e9f50216d89eab29d4bb6d30f9fa7dccb8e551bc9437ac79ef0973) is the rollback; reinstalling it restores stock but wipes data (different signature).
v1.0.11 (2026-11-07, in-place update, profile/settings preserved). Rollback 1.0.10 in apps/atlantic-1.0.10.apk.

Upstream v7.4 (2026-11-15, replaces the 7.1 fork build; fork features gone). Providers live in iptv_prefs.xml; 2 of 13 in and green as of 2026-11-18: Rebel Live (self-hosted rebeliptv v1.5.2, key-authenticated playlist via localhost.run tunnel) and Sports Fallback. The Rebel Live API key and the full playlist URL are never committed. 11 providers + 101 favorites still to restore; v7.5 update pending until the restore verifies.
